title: Quiz Keep At Least
prompt: A quiz report should hide small quiz scores. Write a function that returns a new array containing only values greater than or equal to the minimum.

explanation.beginner:
Example: quizKeepAtLeast([72,88,91,64], 80) produces [88,91]. Evaluate the selection rule for every record and preserve the qualifying values in the required order.

Compare “handles empty input”: input [[],80] produces []. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
Evaluate the selection rule for every record and preserve the qualifying values in the required order.

Tempting mistake: Selecting a display position after a list changes can identify the wrong item. Use the domain key when matching two collections.

The reference uses filter. Trace the intermediate value after each operation; count repeated scans inside callbacks separately when estimating cost.
